messages:
isabel_chang: FYI prospect ClearVault wants to start a 10-day POC. Security redlined KMS section: they need BYO-HSM support, attestation, and an allowlist. Can we list the minimal items to unblock dev smoke tests?

diego_martin: Minimal to unblock POC runs: 1) firewall allowlist (CIDR + ports); 2) vendor attestation artifact (FIPS report or signed cert); 3) short key matrix: algorithms, key types, whether CMKs are exportable.

isabel_chang: Procurement asked whether they must do the offline ceremony before the POC. Any fast path?

nina_sato: Offer staged plan: Phase 1 = Redwood-managed keys for functional/smoke tests (no ceremony, <48h). Phase 2 = proxied BYO-HSM for security validation using vendor attestation. Phase 3 = offline key ceremony for Prod. Call out perf: proxied HSM adds ~6-12ms per op.

diego_martin: Paste this allowlist snippet for their networking team:

diego_martin: 34.220.11.22/32:443 primary proxy endpoint
34.220.11.23/32:443 failover endpoint
Outbound: TCP 443 required, TCP 5000-5005 optional health checks

isabel_chang: Billing question: do we charge for the ceremony/handshake coordination?

nina_sato: Yes 1: one-time onboarding fee for ceremony coordination + dry-run. Also monthly connector fee if they keep BYO in POC. I'll add the SKU in the quote.

diego_martin: Security snippet to paste into questionnaire: Please attach: (a) vendor-signed HSM attestation or FIPS validation report; (b) key lifecycle diagram showing generation, wrapping, rotation frequency; (c) allowlist CIDRs and ports your network team will open; (d) statement whether CMKs are exportable.

isabel_chang: Timeline ask: if artifacts arrive by Mon AM we can do firewall test Tue, proxied handshake Wed, and a dry-run ceremony Thu. Ops to confirm observers.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "ClearVault POC KMS prep" 2026-05-10T15:00Z. Invites: isabel_chang, diego_martin, nina_sato.

isabel_chang: I'll send the excerpt + allowlist + staged plan to the customer. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
